1. IPv6 server names crash 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>_split_server_name treats the first colon inside a bracketed IPv6 address as the port separator,
>so valid values such as [::1] and [::1]:5000 raise ValueError. Consequently, Flask.run()
>cannot start using an IPv6 SERVER_NAME that the previous URL-based parsing handled correctly.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/app.py[R81-82]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6248/files#diff-d3e0349504081bb501c611b3954be364188a4cf442056181272e27e830ae446eR81-R82) > >```diff >+ host, _, port = value.partition(":") >+ return host, int(port) if port else None >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The helper partitions every value at its first colon and converts the entire remainder to an
>integer. run() invokes it for every configured SERVER_NAME and uses its result as the server
>bind host and port; the documented configuration explicitly represents a host and optional port.
>
> > [src/flask/app.py[80-82]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/app.py/#L80-L82) > [src/flask/app.py[725-742]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/app.py/#L725-L742) > [src/flask/app.py[673-678]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/app.py/#L673-L678) > [docs/config.rst[279-287]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/docs/config.rst/#L279-L287) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The new `SERVER_NAME` parser splits on the first colon, which misparses bracketed IPv6 literals and raises `ValueError` before the development server starts. > >## Issue Context >`SERVER_NAME` supplies both the default host and port to `Flask.run()`. Preserve the previous URL-authority behavior for hostnames, optional ports, and bracketed IPv6 addresses, and add regression tests for `[::1]` and `[::1]:5000`. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/app.py[80-82] >- src/flask/app.py[725-742] >- tests/test_basic.py[1785-1836] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
2. IPv6 session cookies disappear 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>_cookie_host returns "[" for [::1]:5000 and an empty string for ::1, rather than the IPv6
>hostname. session_transaction() therefore stores its saved session cookie against a nonmatching
>host, so subsequent IPv6 client requests do not receive the modified session.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/testing.py[R125-127]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6248/files#diff-8b6ebc456dd7ce1ab0df544ee20d38211b947ad84e600b2727e4dd5db9fe913eR125-R127) > >```diff >+ @staticmethod >+ def _cookie_host(value: str) -> str: >+ return value.partition(":")[0] >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>The temporary session request is built from the configured request authority, then the new helper's
>result is passed directly to Werkzeug's cookie update path. The existing session test establishes
>that cookies written by session_transaction() must be available to the next client request, which
>cannot occur when an IPv6 request host is reduced to "[".
>
> > [src/flask/testing.py[65-86]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/testing.py/#L65-L86) > [src/flask/testing.py[125-127]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/testing.py/#L125-L127) > [src/flask/testing.py[164-186]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/src/flask/testing.py/#L164-L186) > [tests/test_testing.py[157-171]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/b1050752312650d01225000cfaa50bb5f23bc892/tests/test_testing.py/#L157-L171) >
>
>Agent prompt >

Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The test client's new cookie-host helper splits at the first colon, producing an invalid cookie host for IPv6 request authorities and preventing session cookies from matching later requests. > >## Issue Context >Restore URL-aware hostname extraction or implement equivalent handling for bracketed IPv6 literals. Add a `session_transaction` regression test that modifies a session under an IPv6 base URL and verifies that a subsequent request receives it. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/testing.py[125-127] >- src/flask/testing.py[164-186] >- tests/test_testing.py[157-171] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
